This entry is the cleanest illustration in the round of why a ZERO must be recorded as a zero and not as absence: crude fibre, NDF, ADF, lignin and starch are all printed as 0, which is correct - molasses is a sugar syrup with no cell wall left in it - and a loader that treated 0 as missing would throw away a real measurement.
